description: What changes a document's documentId and revision. Windows implements it in DocumentTab (Typedown.Core); the Uno port must reproduce the same rows. Each row starts from a document at revision r with id d.

cases.action: type one character in visual or source mode
load into the editor with no edit (FileLoaded handshake returns the source)
FileLoaded handshake returns text other than the source
switch to another tab and back
reload from disk with different text
reload from disk with the same text
open a file into a new tab
open a file into a reused preview or blank tab
open a file into a reused tab, reading the file fails
new untitled document, in a new tab or the reused blank tab

notes: revision is interpreted with the process instanceId; it restarts with the process.
loadId is the host/WebView staleness tag and changes on every load and tab switch; it is never exposed as revision.
A MarkdownChange whose origin is "editor" (services/changeOrigin.ts) still changes the text and so still advances revision; origin decides attribution, not whether the text changed.
